function: Downlink CSI feedback: gossip-trained GAN generates synthetic CSI to train the CsiNet autoencoder (compression and reconstruction), also against catastrophic forgetting when users change area (pp. 6-7).
system: FDD massive MIMO-OFDM downlink: BS with 32 antennas, single-antenna UEs, 32 subcarriers, 25 paths, 0.05 GHz bandwidth; DeepMIMO O1_28 at 28 GHz (pp. 3, 8).
method: Generative adversarial network (CTGAN-style, earth-mover loss) trained by fully decentralized gossip learning among UEs; CsiNet autoencoder then trained on synthetic CSI with MSE loss (pp. 5-7).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing O1_28 (28 GHz), dense area (BS15) and sparse area (BS4), first 10,000 samples each, 5000 train and 5000 test; COST2100 only for loss comparison (p. 8).
test_conditions: Train and test within each area (5000/5000); mobility test evaluates sparse-area models in the dense area and conversely, before and after the proposed adaptation (Table VI, p. 11).
baselines: Learned only: centralized GAN, unconnected-UE GAN, FL-trained CsiNet, federated GAN Sync D&G, CsiNet on true CSI, retraining with stored CSI; no compressed sensing or codebook comparison (pp. 8-12).
metrics: NMSE in dB between true and recovered CSI; FLOPs, memory and per-epoch time (Table IV); parameters transmitted (0.455M) and stored model memory (pp. 8-12).
complexity: Order O(NtNc + n_peers K T log(NtNc)) for the framework; Table IV: 0.98T FLOPs, 7.142M memory, 2.977 s per epoch versus 9.8T, 42.296M, 25.784 s centralized (pp. 8-9).
openness: No code of its own; trains and tests on the public DeepMIMO dataset, link https://www.deepmimo.net/ (p. 3, footnote 1).
q1_support: p. 3: "3-D ray tracing DeepMIMO dataset [34] to verify the" effectiveness; the O1_28 scenario at 28 GHz is used for training and testing (p. 8).
q2_support: p. 11: "when the user moves to a new scene (dense area)," Table VI (p. 11) tests the sparse-area model of the proposed framework in the dense area (-1.29 dB), then reports adaptation (-14.75 and -18.51 dB, p. 12).
q3_support: p. 8: "our proposed Gossip-GAN framework with three counterparts:" all counterparts are learned (centralized GAN, unconnected GAN, FL-CsiNet; Sync D&G on p. 9); compressed sensing and codebooks appear only in the introduction (p. 1), not as a baseline.
q4_support: p. 8: "training is O(Nt Nc ). The computational complexity order" and the total O(NtNc + n_peers K T log(NtNc)); p. 9: "the computational complexity, memory consumption, and the" time per epoch, Table IV: 0.98T FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 8: "DeepMIMO is a publicly available" dataset, used for training and testing; its link is given in p. 3 footnote 1. The authors release no code of their own.
notes: Included as area 2 (CSI feedback and channel synthesis); the gossip training is digital device-to-device learning without over-the-air aggregation, so area 7 does not apply. q2 rests on Table VI (p. 11), the cross-area test and adaptation. q3 is 0 because every compared method is learned.
